optimized_sql:
WITH preagg AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
        d_year AS d_year,
        d_qoy AS d_qoy,
        d_moy AS d_moy,
        SUM(COALESCE(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0)) AS sales_value
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        i_category AS i_category,
        i_class AS i_class,
        i_brand AS i_brand,
        i_product_name AS i_product_name,
        d_year AS d_year,
        d_qoy AS d_qoy,
        d_moy AS d_moy,
        s_store_id AS s_store_id,
        sumsales AS sumsales,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC) AS rk
    FROM (
        SELECT
            i_category AS i_category,
            i_class AS i_class,
            i_brand AS i_brand,
            i_product_name AS i_product_name,
            p.d_year AS d_year,
            p.d_qoy AS d_qoy,
            p.d_moy AS d_moy,
            s_store_id AS s_store_id,
            SUM(p.sales_value) AS sumsales
        FROM preagg p
        INNER JOIN item ON p.item_sk = i_item_sk
        INNER JOIN store ON p.store_sk = s_store_sk
        GROUP BY ROLLUP (
            i_category,
            i_class,
            i_brand,
            i_product_name,
            p.d_year,
            p.d_qoy,
            p.d_moy,
            s_store_id
        )
    ) AS dw1
) AS dw2
WHERE rk <= 100
ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk
LIMIT 100
